content.text:
CI is failing for two independent, likely flaky reasons—not a release-code assertion failure:

- [macOS unit job](https://github.com/jdx/mise/actions/runs/34805088009/job/103856914774): three MCP command-graph tests took 1.022–1.035s, barely exceeding the new 1-second Nextest limit from [#13120](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/13120). The same SHA’s parallel PR workflow passed them at roughly 0.989–1.003s, confirming the timeout is too close to normal runtime.
- [release E2E tranche 4](https://github.com/jdx/mise/actions/runs/34805089440/job/103869290692): `cli/test_system_install_brew_source_slow` could not download GNU Hello from `ftpmirror.gnu.org`. All three attempts timed out three times at 30 seconds each.

The `test-ci` and `release` failures are only aggregate jobs reflecting those failures. A rerun may clear both, but the durable fix is to give the MCP tests a larger timeout; the GNU mirror failure is external network flakiness.
